snippet.title: Galactic Vault - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Galactic Vault release date trailer for this upcoming fast-paced FPS roguelite where you build your weapon to its full potential. 

Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Galactic Vault will be available on PC (Steam) on March 10, 2026, and a demo is out now on Steam.

#GalacticVault #Roguelike
